internetradio.description:
InternetRadio is an open-source internet radio app that lets you discover and listen to radio stations from around the world.

Explore stations by country, language, or genre, save your favorites, and enjoy your preferred broadcasts wherever you go.

Features:

- Discover radio stations worldwide.
- Search by country, language, and tags.
- Save favorite stations.
- Keep track of listening history.
- Record radio streams.
- Schedule playback.
- Clean, modern Android interface.

Open source and powered by the community.
